source_label: B&Q product details and customer reviews for Tower T16043GRY
praise: The grey-and-rose-gold finish is a recurring positive in B&Q's customer comments, and several owners also mention easy cleaning. Other comments describe good results with casseroles and a large beef joint—useful everyday examples if you mainly cook family dinners.
before_buying: B&Q lists a 42cm width and 29.3cm depth, so measure the space where you plan to use and store it. Its controls offer low, high and keep-warm settings; check whether that simple setup suits your routine before choosing it over a programmable model.
verdict: This looks a sensible option for family meals or batch cooking if you want straightforward controls and a cooker you are happy to leave on the worktop. If a compact footprint or programmable timing matters more to you, compare those features before letting the attractive finish decide.

source_label: eBay product reviews for the Design Series 7-Quart thermal-bag model
praise: One product reviewer reports a successful bone-broth result with a pre-owned unit. That is an encouraging cooking example, although it is an individual experience rather than proof that every unit will perform the same way.
before_buying: The 7-quart size and thermal-bag bundle make this worth comparing if you cook larger batches or take food to gatherings. Confirm the exact model, included bag and return terms on the current listing, especially when comparing new and pre-owned offers.
verdict: We would shortlist it for someone who values the carrying-bag bundle alongside a larger cooker. For everyday meals at home, compare the price with a model without the bag and decide whether you will actually use the extra accessory.
